text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Dirt Derby is about to<n>begin. Excusing
ourselves from<n>summer camp, we've arrived at Oi
Racecourse, which is already packed<n>full of excited
fans.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: No biting today, Shinko Windy!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Not that I wouldn't like to see it in<n>person! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I made sure to remind Windy not to<n>lash out
recklessly when the crowd<n>tries to tease and
heckle her.
choice_data_list: (You have to stay focused right now.)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (Damn it! Control yourself, Windy...)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(...Today's the day I show 'em all<n>who they're
messin' with!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh... Why can't I shave my time<n>down? It
actually keeps getting<n>worse!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I can't give up, though. Not now, not<n>ever...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Is this my limit? I've done so much,<n>yet I still
can't manage a single win...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Am I doomed to never become a<n>hero? Maybe I
should just withdraw<n>from the Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I lost track of time. Windy's race is<n>about to begin...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Windy is racing in a G1... I hope she<n>doesn't go and
cause any trouble<n>this time...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't get my hopes up, but I'm<n>still rooting for
her. Oh! Want to watch<n>with us, Biko? They're
doing fan<n>interviews next.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I doubt she'd try to pull any crazy<n>stunts in a G1,
but, man... it'd be<n>hilarious if she does! We're in for
a<n>show, one way or another! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Has she really learned her lesson?<n>She never
explained herself after the<n>incident, and she hasn't
posted on<n>Umatter in ages...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I'm scared she'll bite my<n>fav. The track
is hallowed ground, and<n>I want her to respect it.
Why are<n>people taking this so lightly?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I understand where you all are<n>coming from,
but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It was just one time... Why is she still<n>being
hounded for her mistake even<n>now?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph! I'm not lettin' it get to me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Cause I've got my ambition to fulfill.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Windy looks so calm in the paddock...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Despite being jeered at and taunted<n>from all
angles, she isn't buckling<n>one bit. In fact, she looks
dignified,<n>even...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: How can she remain so strong...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I wonder... how she'll run in today's<n>race...
